integrated_interpretation: Raw cross-region transfer was below chance; unsupervised adaptation recovered part of the discrimination loss; a large gap to within-region performance remained. Feature-level univariate AUC direction reversals indicate that marginal feature-label relationships are not stable across regions, a pattern consistent with residual concept/relationship shift. This does NOT prove causality and does NOT establish that concept shift is the only source of transfer failure; AUC below 0.5 is a direction, not poor performance, and is never inverted.
